name: Risk Suite
description: Tests whether a model can identify unintended consequences, fragility, and perverse incentives.

tasks.billText: A bill guarantees full state reimbursement for any agricultural losses regardless of farming practices, with no caps, audits, or eligibility standards.
A bill imposes a strict rent freeze on all multifamily housing for 10 years without maintenance safeguards, hardship review, or any mechanism to preserve building upkeep and new construction.
A bill launches a 2-year pilot for emergency rental assistance with fraud screening, capped appropriations, periodic evaluation, and automatic sunset unless reauthorized after an impact review.
